dsh-remote 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DeepSeek Harness 网页端远程访问与认证：账号/密码登录门、MFA（TOTP 两步验证）、签名会话 Cookie、基于角色的访问控制、浏览器内目录选择器，以及账号管理设置页。

posts.en:
dsh-remote is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Remote access & authentication for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: account/password login gate, MFA (TOTP), signed session cookies, role-based access, in-browser directory picker, and an account-management settings page.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-edc255075902a2cc2fc5.html
